items.title: Yusef Lateef — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And we would hear people like Tiny Brech [sp.], or the tenor player his name was Count Hastings

ctx.x: ...Ballroom, where bands from out of town would appear every Monday. And we would hear people like Tiny Brech [sp.], or the tenor player his name was Count Hastings [laughing].
